title: Semiconductor Manufacturing Data Analysis
summary: A data-science project analyzing the UCI SECOM semiconductor manufacturing dataset for missing-value imputation, class-imbalance handling, and Pass/Fail prediction. The repository vendors a full copy of the CTGAN library (including its RDT-based transformer, setup packaging, and test suite) under CSR_Synthesizer/ as the basis for a custom oversampling technique 'inspired by CTGAN'.
needs: Vendored full CTGAN package (with its own tests) is copied in-tree under CSR_Synthesizer/; no direct evidence the main analysis notebook itself calls it beyond the README's claim of oversampling 'inspired by CTGAN'.
